name: asset-l10-dispersal-pipes-b
note: L10 dispersal pipes on the port grid: tee +X port meets the elbow port; the elbow turns toward +Y. Look for: flanges touching without gap or overlap, supports reach the ground, the elbow arc closes cleanly. The game camera never zooms out past 1.0 (about 20 m across): pieces taller or wider than that are seen in part, which is the intended monumental read.
